question: Should OpenClaw adopt the installation-wide `gateway-cache.sqlite` plus `client-state.sqlite` ownership and migration contract for Apple now, with Android following separately?
rationale: This PR changes durable user-state ownership and upgrade behavior across native apps; source-level correctness cannot decide whether the intended long-term cross-platform contract is acceptable.

options.title: Sponsor the Apple contract
options.body: Confirm the two-store ownership model and require an explicit upgrade matrix for shipped iOS and macOS legacy stores before merge.

options.title: Pause for cross-platform design
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers decide whether Android must first share a reviewed conceptual migration contract.

options.title: Retain existing storage boundaries
options.body: Decline the new installation-wide model and close this PR if per-gateway storage remains the desired native-app contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Apple contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the two-store ownership model and require an explicit upgrade matrix for shipped iOS and macOS legacy stores before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked architecture proposal and implementation, making them the best available technical routing contact for a maintainer decision.
